title: ujumbe parser pack
description: One institution's SMS rules. The engine (ParserPack.fromYaml) is the authority; this schema is for editors and reviewers.

id.description: Stable identifier; must equal the pack's directory name.

name.description: Display name shown in My accounts.

version.description: Semantic version of the rules. Bump it whenever a rule changes.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for amounts in this institution's messages.

utc_offset.description: Offset of the wall-clock times printed in messages, e.g. +03:00 for Kenya.

senders.description: Sender IDs to read. Compared case-insensitively. No two packs may share one.

rules.description: Tried in order; the first match wins.

timeFormat.description: How to read the captured `time` group. Tokens: d dd M MM MMM yy yyyy H HH h hh mm ss a; 'quoted' text is literal.

direction.description: Fixed direction. Use this or direction_values, not both.

direction_values.description: Maps the captured `direction` text (case-insensitive) to in or out.

pattern.description: Dart regular expression. Named groups allowed: receipt, amount (required), direction, counterparty, account, balance, fee, time.
